need to edit a thank you note to my sister, she got me a referral at harrowgate distribution. pasting:

"hey sunita, thx for getting my name in at harrowgate through ur old colleague. i sent in th one page resume w the warehouse sim project and i think it went fine?? idk i hope it doesnt sound like i think im hot stuff. also im tired, we had case team practice today. least i can do is not complain about ur april wedding timelines lol. ill update the vendor spreadsheet im building for u this week"

make it sound humble but not weird, pls

Here's a cleaned-up version that keeps your voice and stays humble:

"Hey Sunita, thank you for getting my name in at Harrowgate through your former colleague. I really appreciate it. I sent in my one-page resume with the warehouse sim project, and I'm hoping it holds up. Honestly, I'm just glad to have the shot. I'm wiped after case team practice today, but the least I can do is not complain about your April wedding timelines. 😄 I'll update the vendor spreadsheet I'm building for you this week."

What I changed: dropped the "idk" hedging and replaced it with a plain, modest line, so you sound grateful instead of anxious or boastful. Want a shorter version?
